hero.title: Liquid Cooling Height & Load
hero.copy: Compare current deployment needs with space and load reserves for future equipment.

diagram.title: Liquid-cooled room section
diagram.description: Two liquid-cooled rack rows have supply/return piping below the floor and fiber trays, two-tier power trays, fire protection and return-air space above.
diagram.note: Vertical dimensions share one scale: 1.0m underfloor + 2.3m racks + 1.8m overhead services = 5.1m. Adding 1.4m for fire protection and return air gives 6.5m clearance below beams. Floor thickness is a line symbol and is excluded from the zone dimensions.

drawing.load: Slab load ≥20–25 kN/m² · Future supernode deployment

details.spaceCopy: Plan at least 7.5m floor-to-floor height and 6.5m clearance below beams to reserve space for future supernodes and evolving building services.
details.waterCopy: Provide at least 1.0m clear height beneath the raised floor for liquid supply/return mains and branches, separating water below from power above.
details.loadCopy: Plan a room slab load capacity of at least 20–25kN/m² to accommodate future supernode deployments.

comparison.currentNote: For the current generation: supports present equipment deployment, liquid piping and slab load needs.
comparison.futureNote: Reserve more height, piping space and slab capacity for future supernodes.
